verdict.rationale: Riskified documents a Chargeback Gateway Integration for Braintree, Stripe, Adyen and PayPal that it says automates end-to-end chargeback handling, from chargeback reporting through the disputing process. That covers automated dispute handling without manual work, but only for those four gateways. Missing for 10: documentation of how evidence is compiled from order, delivery and session data; explicit description of representment submission to the issuer; automated disputing outside the four supported gateways; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, chargeback responses are automated — evidence compiled from order, delivery, and session data and submitted to the issuer without manual copy-paste

citations.quote: this process automates end-to-end chargeback handling from chargeback reporting to the disputing process
to automatically receive chargeback data without requiring custom API implementations
